instructions:
1. Sit on an exercise ball in a split stance with your left foot flat on the floor in front and your right knee back.
2. Let the ball support your hips and keep your torso upright.
3. Lower your hips toward the floor until you feel a stretch in the front of your right hip and thigh.
4. Hold.
5. Switch legs and repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly into the stretch and stop at mild tension.
2. Keep your core braced so your lower back does not arch.
3. Breathe deeply and relax into the hold.
4. Use a firm, well inflated ball for stable support.
name: Exercise ball hip flexor stretch

instructions:
1. Kneel on the floor in a tabletop position with an exercise ball at your right side.
2. Place your right hand on the ball with the arm bent.
3. Roll the ball forward, extending your right arm overhead and lowering your chest toward the floor.
4. Feel the stretch along your right side and back, and hold.
5. Roll the ball back and switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips above your knees for support.
2. Sink your chest down to deepen the stretch along the lats.
3. Move slowly and stop at mild tension to protect the shoulder.
4. Breathe steadily throughout the hold.
name: Exercise ball lat stretch

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with arms at your sides, palms down, and heels resting on an exercise ball.
2. Brace your core and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels.
3. Bend your knees and roll the ball toward your glutes by pulling your heels in.
4. Keep your hips elevated throughout.
5. Slowly extend your legs to roll the ball back out.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips lifted the whole set so the hamstrings stay loaded.
2. Move slowly and with control to manage the unstable ball.
3. Exhale as you curl in, inhale as you extend out.
4. Squeeze your glutes to hold the bridge position steady.
name: Exercise Ball Leg Curl

instructions:
1. Start on your hands and feet with arms and legs straight and an exercise ball under your hips.
2. Slowly lower your body onto the ball so it supports your hips and torso.
3. Let your back gently arch over the ball and feel a stretch in your lower back.
4. Hold for a moment, then return to the start.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lower onto the ball only as far as is comfortable.
2. Let your spine relax over the ball rather than forcing the arch.
3. Breathe deeply and steadily through each rep.
4. Use a well inflated ball for smooth, supported movement.
name: Exercise ball lower back dynamic stretch

instructions:
1. Start on your hands and feet with arms and legs straight and an exercise ball under your hips.
2. Slowly lower your body onto the ball so it supports your hips and torso.
3. Let your back gently arch over the ball and feel a stretch in your lower back.
4. Hold the stretch.
5. Return to the start and repeat.
tips:
1. Lower onto the ball only as far as is comfortable.
2. Relax your spine over the ball instead of forcing the arch.
3. Breathe deeply and steadily through the hold.
4. Use a well inflated ball for stable support.
name: Exercise ball lower back prone stretch
